_comment: CI data-audit gate configuration (scripts/data_audit.py). dataset_dir points at the dataset the repository currently ships. It is EXPECTED to fail on the v1 data in data/prompt_pairs/ — that is the gate catching the audited defects. When the v2 dataset is built (src/dataset_builder_v2.py -> data/v2/), point dataset_dir there; the gate must pass before any release.
